Privacy Policy

Mobile information and text messaging: summary

  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Information sharing with subcontractors that support our services, such as customer service providers, is permitted.
  • All other categories of information sharing described in this policy exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.
  • We do not sell, rent or trade your phone number or your SMS opt-in consent.
  • Reply STOP to any text message to opt out at any time. Reply HELP for help, or email info@tellbid.io.
  • Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

1. Who we are

TELLBID LLC ("TellBid," "we," "us" or "our") is a Florida limited liability company that provides an all-in-one software platform for businesses, including a unified inbox, AI agents, CRM, calendars and appointment reminders, marketing automations, review management, social media planning and website tools, together with onboarding and human support (the "Services").

Our mailing address is 8325 NE 2nd Ave, Ste 349, Miami, FL 33138, United States. You can contact us at info@tellbid.io or +1 (904) 780-6780.

2. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy applies to personal information we collect when you:

  • visit our website at tellbid.io and related pages (the "Website");
  • fill out our forms, book a demo or request a free trial;
  • create an account or use the Services as a customer or customer user;
  • receive or reply to our text messages, WhatsApp messages, emails or phone calls; or
  • otherwise interact with us, for example through support, social media or events.

This policy does not apply to personal information that our customers collect and manage about their own contacts using the Services. That processing is described in Section 10. Our Terms of Service also apply to your use of the Website and the Services.

3. Information we collect

Information you provide to us

  • Contact information: name, email address, mobile phone number, business name and website or social media profile.
  • Business information you share in our forms: for example, the tools you currently use, the advertising platforms you use, your approximate monthly advertising budget and your plans to advertise. We use this information to understand your needs and determine whether our Services are a good fit.
  • Scheduling information: the date and time you choose for a demo or call, and any notes you provide when booking.
  • Account and billing information: login credentials, users you add, plan selection and billing details. Payment card data is processed by our third-party payment processors; we do not store full payment card numbers on our systems.
  • Communications: the content of messages, emails, chats and calls you exchange with us, including support requests and feedback.
  • Consent records: the date, time, source and wording of any consent you give us to receive text messages, WhatsApp messages, emails or calls, and any opt-out requests.

Information collected automatically

  • Device and usage data: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, pages viewed, referring pages, time spent and similar analytics information.
  • Campaign data: marketing parameters included in the link you used to reach us (such as UTM parameters and advertising click identifiers like gclid, fbclid or ttclid), which tell us which ad or campaign brought you to our Website.
  • Cookies and similar technologies: as described in Section 11.

Information from third parties

  • Advertising and social media platforms (for example, lead forms or campaign reports), scheduling tools, integration partners you connect (such as payment, e-commerce or automation tools), and publicly available business information.

4. How we use information

We use personal information to:

  • respond to your requests, schedule and hold demos, and activate and manage free trials;
  • evaluate whether our Services are a good fit for your business, based on the answers you provide;
  • provide, operate, maintain, secure and improve the Services, including customer support and onboarding;
  • send you transactional and service communications, such as appointment confirmations and reminders, account notifications, billing notices and support responses;
  • send you marketing communications, where permitted by law and, where required, with your consent;
  • measure and improve our advertising and Website performance;
  • detect, prevent and respond to fraud, abuse, security incidents and violations of our terms;
  • comply with legal obligations, including record-keeping of consents and opt-outs; and
  • for any other purpose disclosed to you at the time we collect the information, or with your consent.

5. Text messaging (SMS/MMS)

If you provide your mobile phone number and consent to receive text messages from TellBid, we may send you text messages related to your inquiry, demo appointments, free trial, account, customer support and, only if you separately agree, marketing and promotional offers. Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of purchasing any goods or services.

  • Message frequency varies depending on your interactions with us.
  • Message and data rates may apply, according to your mobile carrier plan.
  • Opt out: reply STOP (or CANCEL, END, QUIT, UNSUBSCRIBE or STOP ALL) to any message. We will send one final message confirming your opt-out, and you will not receive further text messages from that program unless you opt in again.
  • Help: reply HELP to any message, email info@tellbid.io or call +1 (904) 780-6780.
  • Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Information sharing with subcontractors that support our services, such as customer service and messaging delivery providers, is permitted only to the extent necessary to provide the messaging service. All other categories of information sharing described in this policy exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

The full SMS program terms are available in our Terms of Service.

6. WhatsApp communications

We use the WhatsApp Business Platform, provided by Meta, to communicate with people who have given us their phone number and agreed to receive WhatsApp messages from us, or who contact us first on WhatsApp. We may send messages related to your inquiry, appointments, account and support and, where you have opted in, marketing messages.

  • Messages sent through WhatsApp are also subject to the WhatsApp Privacy Policy and Meta's terms. Meta processes information such as your phone number, profile name and message metadata to deliver the service.
  • You can stop receiving WhatsApp messages from us at any time by replying STOP, by using the block or report options in WhatsApp, or by emailing info@tellbid.io.
  • We do not share your WhatsApp opt-in consent with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

7. Email and phone calls

Email

We send transactional emails (such as confirmations, reminders and account notices) and, where permitted, marketing emails. Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link and our mailing address, as required by the CAN-SPAM Act. Unsubscribing from marketing emails does not stop transactional or account-related emails.

Phone calls

We may call you at the number you provide to respond to your request, confirm or prepare your demo, or provide support. We will place marketing calls or messages using automated technology or artificial or prerecorded voices only with your prior express written consent, as required by the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and the Florida Telephone Solicitation Act. You can ask us to stop calling you at any time, and we honor internal do-not-call requests.

Calls may be recorded and transcribed for quality, training and service purposes. When we record a call, we will notify you at the beginning of the call, and all parties' consent will be obtained where required by law.

8. Artificial intelligence (AI)

TellBid uses AI technologies, including AI services provided by third-party AI providers, to offer features such as AI agents that answer messages, qualify prospects and book appointments, as well as to help draft content, summarize conversations and improve our support.

  • AI interactions are disclosed. When you communicate with an AI agent operated by TellBid, we will make it clear that you are interacting with an automated assistant, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time.
  • Information processed by AI. The content of messages, the information you provide and the relevant business information may be processed by our AI providers solely to generate responses and perform the requested features on our behalf.
  • No sale or marketing use. We do not sell personal information to AI providers, and we do not allow them to use your personal information for their own marketing purposes.
  • Human oversight. AI-generated responses may contain errors. Our team can review and take over conversations, and important decisions about you are not made solely by automated means without the possibility of human review.
  • No sensitive decisions. We do not use AI features to make decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects about you, such as decisions about credit, employment, housing, insurance or access to essential services.

9. How we share information

We do not sell personal information, and we do not rent or trade your phone number or messaging consent. We share personal information only as described below and always subject to the mobile information restrictions in Section 5:

  • Service providers and subcontractors that perform services on our behalf, such as cloud hosting, CRM and platform infrastructure, telecommunications and messaging delivery (SMS, WhatsApp and email), payment processing, scheduling, AI services, analytics, customer support and security. They may use personal information only to provide services to us.
  • Integrations you request, for example when you connect a third-party tool to your account.
  • Legal and safety reasons, when we believe in good faith that disclosure is required by law, subpoena or legal process, or is necessary to protect the rights, property or safety of TellBid, our customers or others.
  • Business transfers, in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, sale of assets or similar transaction, subject to this policy's commitments.
  • With your consent or at your direction.

We may also share aggregated or de-identified information that cannot reasonably be used to identify you.

10. Data we process for our customers

Our customers use the Services to communicate with their own clients and prospects (for example, through the unified inbox, AI agents, SMS, WhatsApp, email and calendars). For that information ("Customer Data"), the customer is the business responsible for the data, and TellBid acts as a service provider (processor) that processes Customer Data only on the customer's behalf and under its instructions and our agreement with the customer.

Each customer is responsible for providing its own privacy notice, obtaining any required consents (including for text messages, WhatsApp and calls), honoring opt-outs and responding to privacy requests. If you received a message from one of our customers and want to exercise your rights, please contact that business directly. If you contact us, we will forward your request to the relevant customer where appropriate.

11. Cookies and tracking technologies

We and our service providers use cookies, pixels, local storage and similar technologies to operate the Website, remember your preferences, keep track of the campaign that brought you to us during your session, analyze traffic and measure the effectiveness of our advertising.

  • You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may affect how the Website works.
  • We honor recognized opt-out preference signals, such as Global Privacy Control (GPC), where required by applicable law.
  • To the extent our use of advertising cookies or pixels is considered "sharing" or "targeted advertising" under state law, you can opt out by enabling GPC in your browser or by emailing info@tellbid.io.

12. Data retention

We keep personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including to provide the Services, comply with legal, tax and accounting obligations, resolve disputes and enforce our agreements. Records of messaging consent and opt-out requests are kept for at least as long as required to demonstrate compliance with applicable laws. When information is no longer needed, we delete or de-identify it.

13. Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information, including encryption in transit, access controls and limiting access to personnel and service providers who need it. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. If we become aware of a security incident affecting your personal information, we will notify you as required by law, including the Florida Information Protection Act.

14. Your choices and rights

  • Text messages: reply STOP to opt out; reply HELP for help.
  • WhatsApp: reply STOP or block our number in WhatsApp.
  • Email: click "unsubscribe" in any marketing email.
  • Calls: ask us during any call to place you on our internal do-not-call list, or email us.
  • Access, correction and deletion: you can ask us for a copy of your personal information, to correct it or to delete it by emailing info@tellbid.io. We may keep certain information when required or permitted by law, such as consent and opt-out records.

15. State privacy rights

Depending on the state where you live (for example, California, Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Texas, Oregon or Florida), and if the applicable law applies to us, you may have the right to:

  • know or access the personal information we have collected about you and how we use and share it;
  • correct inaccurate personal information;
  • delete personal information;
  • obtain a portable copy of your personal information;
  • opt out of the sale of personal information, "sharing" for cross-context behavioral advertising, targeted advertising and certain profiling (as noted above, we do not sell personal information);
  • limit the use of sensitive personal information (we do not use sensitive personal information to infer characteristics about you); and
  • appeal our decision on your request.

To exercise these rights, email info@tellbid.io with the subject "Privacy Request." We will verify your identity using the information we already have before responding, and we will respond within the time required by law. You may use an authorized agent, who must provide proof of authorization. If we deny your request, you may appeal by replying to our response with the subject "Privacy Appeal." We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

California residents: in the last 12 months we have collected the categories of personal information described in Section 3 (identifiers, commercial information, internet or other electronic network activity, professional or business information and inferences about business needs) for the business purposes described in Section 4, and disclosed them to the categories of recipients described in Section 9. We do not sell personal information and have no actual knowledge of selling or sharing the personal information of consumers under 16.

16. Children's privacy

The Website and Services are intended for businesses and for adults 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or under 16 where applicable law requires), and we do not send text messages to minors. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

17. International users

TellBid is based in the United States and serves businesses in the United States and Latin America. If you access the Website or Services from outside the United States, your information will be transferred to, stored and processed in the United States, where data protection laws may differ from those in your country. Where required by the laws of your country, we will take the steps necessary to protect your information and to honor your rights as a data subject.

18. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will post the updated policy with a new "Last updated" date and, where required by law, notify you by email or through the Services. Changes will not apply retroactively to messaging consents in a way that would expand how we share your mobile information.
